one_line: A one-line "when you have..." text over a close-up of a child's face, ending on the reaction.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 close-up of a girl about 4 to 5 in a pink dress looking up, an adult hand brushing her brow. No speech. Small white text near the top: "כשיש לך בת אחת וכולם בנים:".
q1_hook.why: A "when you have one girl and everyone else is a boy" line is a relatable family moment, and the colon sets up a payoff the Reel delivers at 0:29 (H5, K3, K6). A child's face fills the first frame (K8). The text is tiny (against T5) and no voice opens it (H4).

beats.what: A girl looks up; brow brush, then a powder puff on the cheek; the line of text
beats.why: Face and relatable line from the first frame

beats.what: Eyes closed; pink eyeshadow applied with a sponge applicator
beats.why: A calm step with a visible change

beats.what: She looks at a small mirror and smiles shyly
beats.why: A first small reaction that rewards the wait

beats.what: A lime-yellow tube on the cheek; she giggles
beats.why: A new product and a laugh restart attention

beats.what: Mascara from a lilac tube; a hand at the eye
A red lip product; she puckers her lips
beats.why: The last step, a playful pose

beats.what: She turns away, then smiles at the lens, makeup done
beats.why: The payoff: the finished look and the smile

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: none. The text is a relatable line a mother of a girl among boys might send; there is no ask.
q2_flow.why: A new product every 3 to 6 s moves one steady scene along (R3, E2), small reactions at 0:14 and 0:18 break up the steps (K1), and the smile at 0:29 pays off the opening line (R4, K2). A line a parent would send to a friend (R5).

q3_cta.what: none. No spoken or written ask, no link or product name. The caption is only "בת שילי קטנה".
q3_cta.why: No ask means a viewer who loved it can only like or send it, and nothing can convert, since no product is identified. Its pull comes from the relatable line (R5); none of the CTA principles apply to a Reel that sells nothing.

q4_shown.what: Close-ups of a girl about 4 to 5 in a pink dress as an adult hand applies makeup in steps: brow, pink eyeshadow, cheek tube, mascara, red lips. A small mirror at 0:14; a smile to the lens at the end. No brand or price.
q4_shown.why: The child's shy smile, giggle and final smile are the whole appeal (K8, K1). The products are tools with no identity, so nothing is sold (K5). The child's face is shown in full, and no consent is visible (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 7 shots in 30.5 s (about 4.4 s each), handheld close-ups, cuts at the end of each makeup step, no speed change. One small text box at the top for the whole Reel. No speech. Ends on a smile to the lens.
q5_edit.why: A step every 3 to 6 s with a change of product keeps one scene moving (E2, R3). The smile lands in the last 3 s (R4). The text never changes and is too small to read, so it is pictures only (T2, T5). It ends on the payoff (E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother makes up her young daughter as a princess; the joke is one girl among boys. It serves parents who enjoy a warm family moment, not a purchase need.
q6_topic.why: Everyday warmth with a relatable twist (K3, K6), a clear character and payoff (K2), and a high-arousal positive peak when the child giggles and smiles (K1). It is a family moment, not a buying moment, so it cannot be copied as a product pitch (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Close, eye-level handheld shots of a girl's face in golden window light with a blurred boy behind her; an adult hand with long nails fills the lower frame. The phone is propped close or held by a second person (not seen).
q7_filmed.why: A face filling the frame reads well on a small screen and puts the child's reaction at the centre (F4, K8). Warm window light looks homemade and flattering (F7, H8). Hands cover the face at 0:03-0:05 and 0:12-0:13.

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00 to 0:30 one small two-line white text, thin outline, centred about 17 to 20 percent down, unchanged: "כשיש לך בת אחת" and "וכולם בנים:". It overlaps the child's hair and, at 0:20-0:21, the hand and tube. No other text.
q8_text.caption: "בת שילי קטנה". 3 words, no hashtags, no ask, no product names, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: The line sets the joke in a second and the colon invites the payoff (T3, H5). But the type is tiny and thin and sits near the top zone where the phone's bar and the child's hair compete (T5, T4), and the caption adds nothing searchable (T7).

weak_points: Tiny, thin text that never changes; no product, brand or ask, so nothing converts; hands cover the face for stretches; a child's full face with no visible consent; no voice.
lumebook_takeaway: Use the idea, not the face: a one-line "when you..." text over hands turning the book's pages, ending on the name page. LumeBook's own Reels show no child's face.
not_verified: The makeup brands; who films (a second person or a propped phone); whether the account is a beauty professional; music (the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech). What "בת שילי קטנה" refers to. The blurred boy appears in the background at 0:02, 0:08, 0:19, 0:22 and 0:26.
